title: Deeala at the docks

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Fuck, right, there you are. Fuck! Where were you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck, right, there you are. Fuck! Where were you?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I need to ask you something. Is my eyeliner symmetrical? Don't fuck about. Just yes or no please.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to ask you something. Is my eyeliner symmetrical? Don't fuck about. Just yes or no please.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Good. I'm supposed to start my shift in fifteen minutes at Mollyphonic and there's some dumb tech bro who tips an insane amount when I look presentable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. I'm supposed to start my shift in fifteen minutes at Mollyphonic and there's some dumb tech bro who tips an insane amount when I look presentable.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Fuck. I'm supposed to start my shift in fifteen minutes at Mollyphonic and there's some dumb tech bro who tips an insane amount when I look presentable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck. I'm supposed to start my shift in fifteen minutes at Mollyphonic and there's some dumb tech bro who tips an insane amount when I look presentable.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I need the cash this month. Every day I miss rent, my landlord turns the heat down ten degrees in my apartment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need the cash this month. Every day I miss rent, my landlord turns the heat down ten degrees in my apartment.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: This morning it was so cold my latte became a frappe. I had to bail and do my make-up on the DuoRail.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This morning it was so cold my latte became a frappe. I had to bail and do my make-up on the DuoRail.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You can listen to me bitch. I mean we could talk another time maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can listen to me bitch. I mean we could talk another time maybe.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Right. I like that. You're right. Why should you listen to me bitch and moan? Unless... I'm willing to listen to you bitch and moan back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. I like that. You're right. Why should you listen to me bitch and moan? Unless... I'm willing to listen to you bitch and moan back?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Right, well fuck you very much. I'm kidding. Kinda. I'll see you around. Maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right, well fuck you very much. I'm kidding. Kinda. I'll see you around. Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Okay, well, I'm really fucking busy, but I'll see what I do. I'm gonna be late, I gotta go. Later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, well, I'm really fucking busy, but I'll see what I do. I'm gonna be late, I gotta go. Later.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: The ticket robot asked me if I "was going through something right now."
